description: This file defines the BalsaVisitorInterface class, an interface for handling parsed HTTP message components in the BalsaFrame parser, including headers, body, trailers, and message lines.

classes.name: BalsaVisitorInterface
classes.description: An interface class for processing parsed HTTP message components during frame parsing.

methods.name: OnRawBodyInput
methods.description: Called with raw body data, including chunk framing.

methods.name: OnBodyChunkInput
methods.description: Called with body data excluding chunk framing, suitable for storage.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Called with individual header key-value pairs.

methods.name: OnRequestFirstLineInput
methods.description: Called when the request line is parsed.

methods.name: OnResponseFirstLineInput
methods.description: Called when the response line is parsed.

methods.name: OnChunkLength
methods.description: Called when a chunk length is parsed.

methods.name: OnChunkExtensionInput
methods.description: Called with raw chunk extension data.

methods.name: OnInterimHeaders
methods.description: Called with headers of an interim (1xx) response.

methods.name: ContinueHeaderDone
methods.description: Called when 100 Continue headers are processed.

methods.name: HeaderDone
methods.description: Called when headers are fully processed.

methods.name: MessageDone
methods.description: Called when the entire message is processed.

methods.name: HandleError
methods.description: Called when an error is detected.

methods.name: HandleWarning
methods.description: Called when a warning is detected.
